Configuration Analog load cells
Accuracy class (III) or (IIII)
Weighing range Single interval
Maximum number of scale intervals n ≤ 10000
Load cell excitation voltage 5 V DC
Minimum signal input voltage Umin = 0 mV
Minimum input voltage per verification scale interval 0,5 µV
Minimum load cell resistance 43 Ω
Maximum load cell resistance 1200 Ω
Fraction of the maximum permissible error 0,5
Load cell connection 4-wire
Maximum value of the cable length per cross wire section between the indicator and the junction box or load cells The load cells are connected directly without junction box
Temperature range -10 °C / +40 °C
Power supply voltage 12 – 24 V DC via AC/DC power supply
Software identification Version number: V 1.xx
(xx reflecting non-legally relevant changes)
